rationale: The full notice says the relevant AI issues cannot currently be resolved prescriptively without architectural mitigation. Its later discussion retains the Air System Safety Case and names verification, trials, testing, analysis and continuing performance monitoring when standards are unsuitable or behaviour is unpredictable. The claim reports that bounded MAA position without generalising it to other jurisdictions.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-001-R3 — PDF pp. 3–4, Non-Compliances and Summary
limitations: The statement is the MAA's current UK-military guidance judgment, not proof that every authority lacks a prescriptive method.
It does not demonstrate a completed high-criticality approval case.
